description: Randomize the order of upcoming unpinned queued posts per account while keeping every exact scheduled timestamp slot and active pacing law intact. Posts due within the next 10 minutes and pinned posts stay locked. Ask the user before shuffling a live queue.

accountIds.description: Optional account ids from accounts_list to shuffle; leave out to shuffle every account with 2 or more eligible future queued posts.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: queue_shuffle
title: Shuffle queued posts
